description: Fisheries and Maritime Activity: Global Fishing Watch vessel identity and published fishing-effort aggregates, FAO FishStat capture statistics per release, the ICCAT, WCPFC and IOTC authorised-vessel registers and IUU vessel lists, and the Combined IUU Vessel List, bounded to explicit flag states, areas, species, years and vessels. Every value is quoted as published with its source, snapshot or release and retrieval time; registers are dated snapshots and removals are revisions. Effort is GFW's apparent fishing effort, never confirmed fishing; no illegal-fishing inference, legality status or enforcement recommendation. Access, licence and coverage decisions: docs/development/fisheries-evidence/source-audit.md.

defaults.update_cadence: weekly re-check of the explicit selection; RFMO registers and IUU lists change after commission decisions, FishStat publishes one release a year (plus corrections) and GFW datasets carry their own version
defaults.temporal_semantics: register and list pages are dated snapshots (published date or Last-Modified) with the retrieval time kept beside them; authorisation periods, listing and delisting dates as published; FishStat values belong to a release; GFW aggregates to a dataset version and period; every distinct payload is an immutable revision and absence from a later snapshot of the same list and selection is a dated removal revision

excluded: fishing, encounter, loitering or port events

sources.scope: GFW self-reported vessel identity for explicitly selected GFW vessel ids, and monthly apparent fishing-effort aggregates at the published LOW (0.1 degree) grid, grouped by flag and gear, for the ICCAT convention area over a bounded date range; no tracks, positions or events

license.redistribution: non-commercial use with attribution to Global Fishing Watch and the dataset version; aggregates and identity only (verify the current API terms before any redistribution or commercial use)

fisheries.coverage_decision: two selected vessels plus one unknown id; effort for the ICCAT convention area, January-February 2024, LOW grid, monthly, by flag and gear

selection.label: synthetic purse seiner, renamed and re-flagged

sources.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), FishStat
sources.scope: FishStat global capture production release file, read only for FAO major areas 27, 34 and 51, ASFIS species COD, SKJ and YFT, countries ESP, GHA and NOR and the years 2021-2022; quantities, units and status flags as published, tied to the release

license.redistribution: non-commercial reuse with attribution 'Source: FAO FishStat' and the release; share-alike (verify the release's own notice)

fisheries.coverage_decision: three FAO major areas, three species, three countries and two years; aquaculture not selected
